description: Spec-driven development with smart compaction. Claude Code plugin combining Ralph Wiggum loop with structured specification workflow.
AI-driven autonomous development workflow - Ralph builds while you sleep
Lisa plans. Ralph does. Interactive specification interview workflow for Claude Code that conducts in-depth feature interviews and generates comprehensive specs.

All-in-one workflow plugin—loops, swarms, and teams on Claude Code's Task System. All enforce exit criteria—swarm is   faster with parallel queue execution, teams add contract-first coordination. Plan your way, execute your way. Optional:    Beads for persistent memory, Ralph TUI for dashboard.
A Claude Code plugin that adds structured, customizable workflow formulas to the Ralph loop. Built on Beads.
